title: delphinium carolinianum var. penardii
intro: Delphinium carolinianum var. penardii, commonly known as Carolina larkspur, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Delphinium genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Carolina larkspur include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include delphinine and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
